title: Observer: Runs that end without a PR are re-run until quarantine, whatever the run said
body:
<!-- phoebe-observer finding=engine:stranded-unit-sweep -->

> Proposed by Phoebe's observer from its unit history.

**Category:** engine defect: the fix belongs in Phoebe itself
**Target:** `stranded-unit-sweep`

## What keeps going wrong

When a run on a ticket ends without opening a pull request, the stranded-unit sweep drops the claim and puts the ticket back in the queue, even when the run left a comment explaining that nothing can be done yet. The next run reaches the same conclusion, and after three such runs the ticket is quarantined as unproductive.

title: Observer: Hosted Renovate keeps opening PRs the checks kind cannot fix
body:
<!-- phoebe-observer finding=factory:renovate.json -->

> Proposed by Phoebe's observer from its unit history.

**Category:** factory defect: the fix belongs in `prompts/` or the governing `phoebe.config.ts`
**Target:** `renovate.json`

## What keeps going wrong

Renovate opens dependency PRs whose checks fail, and the `checks` kind's idle CI fix gives up on them. Renovate's schedule should be narrowed so it opens fewer PRs.
